name: dnsenum
summary: Script that enumerates DNS information from a domain, attempts zone transfers, performs a brute force dictionary style attack, and then performs reverse look-ups on the results.
highlights: --dnsserver — <server> Use this DNS server for A, NS and MX queries.
--private — Show and save private ips at the end of the file domain_ips.txt.
--subfile — Write all valid subdomains to this file.
--threads — The number of threads that will perform different queries.
-v — Be verbose: show all the progress and all the error messages.

flags.name: --dnsserver
flags.description: <server> Use this DNS server for A, NS and MX queries.

flags.name: --private
flags.description: Show and save private ips at the end of the file domain_ips.txt.

flags.name: --subfile
flags.description: Write all valid subdomains to this file.

flags.name: --threads
flags.description: The number of threads that will perform different queries.

flags.name: --verbose
flags.description: Be verbose: show all the progress and all the error messages.

flags.name: --pages
flags.description: The number of google search pages to process when scraping names, the default is 5 pages, the -s switch must be specified.

flags.name: --scrap
flags.description: The maximum number of subdomains that will be scraped from Google (default 15).

flags.name: --file
flags.description: Read subdomains from this file to perform brute force. (Takes priority over default dns.txt)

flags.name: --update
flags.description: <a|g|r|z> Update the file specified with the -f switch with valid subdomains. a (all) Update using all results. g Update using only google scraping results. r Update using only reverse lookup results. z Update using only zonetransfer results.

flags.name: --recursion
flags.description: Recursion on subdomains, brute force all discovered subdomains that have an NS record.

flags.name: --delay
flags.description: The maximum value of seconds to wait between whois queries, the value is defined randomly, default: 3s.

flags.name: --whois
flags.description: Perform the whois queries on c class network ranges. **Warning**: this can generate very large netranges and it will take lot of time to perform reverse lookups.

flags.name: --exclude
flags.description: Exclude PTR records that match the regexp expression from reverse lookup results, useful on invalid hostnames.
